Mapping key normalization collision detection across domain contracts, review packs, and contract_bindings keys prevents last-write-wins. Legacy description-only rules are indexed without ID fabrication, participating as advisory content without crashing contracts_context.

F2_explicit_requirement_and_compatibilit.mechanism: Explicit selected_contract_pack emits typed selected_contract_pack_missing:<name> when pack cannot be resolved across absent, present-valid empty, or present-valid no-match source states, without requiring non-empty packs. Matcher split: modern_pack_matches_selected strictly requires exact pack identity (plus frozen calendar alias), while legacy_pack_matches_selected preserves extensional baseline fuzzy substring matching for legacy flat sources. F3_projection_fixed_point_closure.mechanism: Candidate contract limitations derived during candidate evaluation are included directly into the monotonic ascent fixed-point packing loop, ensuring all limitation strings that alter terminal payload size participate in projection before admission, guaranteeing projected min hunk chars bounds real builder chars.

F4_required_semantic_context_closure.mechanism: Applicable packs establishing explicit relations/bindings to required contracts are marked required=True and preserved in the required semantic floor. The payload shrink ladder pops optional packs without bindings first, then optional domain contracts; if required packs cannot fit under extreme budget pressure, it pops them and emits typed critical loss required_contract_pack_context_lost:<id>, degrading results and forcing quality gate != passed.
